studio.name: INSAN CREATIONS
studio.tagline: Software, assistants, and tools made to actually run on the machines people have.
studio.about: INSAN CREATIONS is a small independent studio. We build lightweight apps and experiments — starting with J.A.R.V.I.S, a personal Windows assistant designed for ordinary laptops, not only high-end PCs. New creations can be added here without rebuilding the site.

products.name: J.A.R.V.I.S
products.phases: Phase 1 [EARLY ACCESS] · Phase 2 [EARLY ACCESS FINAL ACT]
products.blurb: A local personal AI assistant for Windows: voice, chat, apps, privacy permissions. Built for Intel i3, 8 GB RAM, and HDD-class machines.
